  • Method Details

    • load

      public static void load(GTFSDataSource source, TransitNetwork.Builder builder, Range<LocalDate> dateRange, Predicate<GeoLocation> locationFilter, boolean allowBrokenRoutes, GTFSProgressListener progress, AtomicReference<Runnable> cancel, BiConsumer<GeoLocation, GeoLocation> edgeLocationConsumer) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Loads the specified GTFS data source.
      Parameters:
      source - the data source, not null
      builder - the network builder, not null
      dateRange - the data range, not null
      locationFilter - the location filter, not null
      allowBrokenRoutes - if true, routes can be split up if there are missing stop coordinates, not null
      progress - the progress listener, not null
      cancel - the cancel operation to pass to the progress listener, no null
      edgeLocationConsumer - a consumer for pairs of geolocations connected by an edge
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error was encountered in parsing the data source
      InterruptedException - if the thread was interrupted
